Question: Agar hum per gold ki zakat 2002 sai due hai then zakat calculate karne ke liye hum gold ka per year rate leker karenge ya jis year mai zakat paid karenge usi year ka gold ka rate leker zakat calculate karni hogi. early jawab ka muntazir. Answer ID: 10018 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 118/90=H/1429) For example, in 2002 you owned 100 gm gold, then 2.50 gm gold was the due Zakah; so, deduct the same quantity from it. Again in 2003, deduct 2.5% of total 97.5 gm as Zakah. Repeat the same process in 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007 and 2008. You shall have to pay the total quantity of gold in Zakah. Also, you can pay the price of the gold as per the market rate of every concerning year. It is to be noted that the Zakah will be calculated according to the lunar calendar; therefore it is advisable to you to pay some extra amount as Zakah from 2002-2008 and in future calculate it as per the lunar calendar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
